blocks.title: Polyanalytic Bargmann-Fock spaces
Berezin density asymptotics for an exterior point
blocks.content:
We show that the Berezin measures have the convergence ${\mathrm d}B^{\langle z\rangle}_{m,n,q}\to{\mathrm d}\omega_z$ for $z\in{\mathbb D}^e$ as $m,n\to+\infty$ while $n=m+\mathrm{O}(1)$. Here, $\omega_z$ is harmonic measure with respect to the point $z$ and the exterior disk $\mathbb{D}^e$.

We first study the concentration of the Berezin measure to neighborhoods of the closed unit disk $\bar{\mathbb D}$. We recall the standard notation ${\mathbb D}(z_0,\rho)$ for the open disk of radius $\rho$ centered at $z_0$.

blocks.title: Poly-Bargmann transforms
blocks.content:
In this section, we discuss the poly-Bargmann transforms, a generalization of the classical Bargmann transform, which are needed later when we analyze the Berezin density at a boundary point. The poly-Bargmann transforms appeared in Vasilevski's paper [@vas], where the basic properties were presented.

blocks.title: Reproducing kernel and Berezin density asymptotics for a boundary point
blocks.content:
In this section, we will calculate the limit of the blow-up berezin transform $\hat{\berd}^{\langle z\rangle}_{m,n,q}$ at a boundary point $z$, that is, $|z|=1$. There is no loss of generality to take $z=1$. Our strategy is to investigate the blow-up of the reproducing kernel of the space of analytic polynomials $\mathrm{Pol}_{m,n,1}$ (with $q=1$) first, and then use this information together with poly-Bargmann transform to lift the the asymptotics to the context of the general polyanalytic spaces $\mathrm{Pol}_{m,n,q}$.
